title: Empty input and whitespace-only input
summary: An input of zero bytes and an input holding only spaces, a tab, CRLF and a newline.
rationale: The floor of the corpus. If any tool raises a finding here it has failed before looking at content, and offsets computed on empty input are a classic source of crashes.
unscopedReason: Authored detector and arrival-target metadata intentionally assign no credential family; this fixture remains a global benchmark control.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. There are no non-whitespace bytes, so no credential can be present.
